A Valentine’s card that blushes, runs and asks nicely

Skip the forwarded image. This Valentine card arrives as a sealed envelope. Inside is a love letter written just for them, a shy teddy holding a rose, and one small question that the No button refuses to answer. Add your photos together, pick a romantic music-box tune, and send it on WhatsApp.

Make a valentine card · ₹30

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it. Now ₹30, usually ₹35.

What’s in your valentine card

  • A sealed envelope with a heart seal that opens to a love letter
  • A shy teddy that runs in holding a rose
  • Your photos as polaroids, with captions like “first date”
  • The question “Will you be my Valentine?”, or write your own
  • A “No” button that runs away, and a sad teddy if they chase it
  • Hearts, fireworks and a hug when they say yes

Message ideas you can borrow

I have been thinking about how to say this for a while. Every day with you feels a little softer and a little brighter.
Roses are red, my cheeks are too, every single time I get a message from you. So here goes nothing…
You are my favourite hello and my hardest goodbye. Be my Valentine?

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹30 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Can I write my own Valentine question?

Yes. “Will you be my Valentine?” is filled in for you, and you can change it to anything up to 100 characters.

Does the other person need to install an app?

No. They just tap your link and the card opens in their browser, on any phone.

What music can I use?

Pick from three built-in tunes: a music box, a happy one or a dreamy one. Songs are not uploaded, so nothing of yours is stored.
